note: Everything the Windows setup downloads besides the Python packages, pinned by checksum. The packages are pinned, with their checksums, in requirements-windows.txt and torch-<profile>.txt. Each "urls" list is tried in order, and every copy is checked against the same checksum.

python.note: 3.12.10 is the last 3.12 with a Windows build from python.org; later 3.12 releases are source-only security fixes. macOS uses 3.12.14 from python-build-standalone.

ffmpeg.note: The GitHub copy is the same file (checked 22 September 2026).

people.note: Person detector weights. The ultralytics library itself is in requirements-windows.txt. Ultralytics is AGPL-3.0.
